headerDisplay: Uses your Whisker app account. Scoped to four things: how full the waste drawer is, telling it you emptied it, whether anything is wrong, and running a cycle now. A clean cycle is refused while the robot reports a cat in the globe.

exposeDrawerAlert.title: Expose a "Drawer Full" sensor
exposeDrawerAlert.description: Carries the same fact as the waste drawer gauge, on a service that is certain to appear and can trigger an automation. Turn off once you have confirmed the gauge itself is visible.

exposeResetSwitch.title: Expose an "Empty Drawer" switch
exposeResetSwitch.description: The waste drawer service carries its own reset, but it may not be reachable by touch in the Home app. This switch always is.

alertWhenPoweredOff.title: Treat a switched-off robot as needing attention
alertWhenPoweredOff.description: A tripped breaker, an unplugged cord or a knocked switch all look the same to the cloud, and none of them is intentional.

litterLowPercent.title: Litter low threshold (percent)
litterLowPercent.description: Only consulted when the robot does not report a litter state of its own.

staleMinutes.title: Treat data older than this as not reporting in
staleMinutes.description: The cloud sometimes claims a robot is online while serving a reading hours old.

removeStale.title: Remove robots no longer on the account
